records.name: Athletic Base Ball Club of Philadelphia
records.summary: A nonprofit club that plays and teaches base ball the way it was played in the 1860s. It puts on live games and demonstrations for the public, and it welcomes new players and umpires.
records.what_you_do: Play in period style games, umpire them (the club calls its umpires arbiters), or join as a non-playing supporting member who backs the club's mission.

schedule.text: Game and demonstration dates were not posted when checked. The club says its schedule will be updated and asks people to follow it on social media.

cost.text: Membership and uniform costs are listed on the site but were not recorded.

first_step.how: Email info@phillyvintagebaseball.org or use the site's contact form to ask about playing, umpiring, or membership
first_step.basis: The club says interest is the only requirement to play or umpire and offers a first year membership discount, but it does not describe a sign up step beyond contacting it.

records.notes: IRS legal name: Athletic Base Ball of Philadelphia Inc. The site says the club was founded in 1859 and revived in 2009. No dated events or news appear on the site. The only dated item is a sitemap modified date of 2026-05-18, which is not an event, so status is probably_active rather than active. The IRS contact name (Timothy Rinehart) does not appear on the site, so it is not recorded. The IRS street address (2333 S Rosewood St) is not confirmed as a game location, so no location is recorded. Social handles as published: Instagram athleticbaseballclub, Twitter AthleticBBC, Facebook AthleticBBC.

records.name: Barefoot Artists
records.notes: IRS legal name: Barefoot Artists Incorporated, with a Philadelphia office address (2412 Waverly St) on the filing. The site describes arts projects in other countries and names no Philadelphia program, class, volunteer role, or event sign up. The only public step is a newsletter form, which the site itself says may not be working yet. Dated items on the site: a TED talk premiere on 2024-12-04, and an award to be received on November 28, 2026 (a future event, not used as evidence of activity). The contact page was linked but could not be read. Hidden as private until a public Philadelphia way in is shown.

records.name: Black Starr Inc
records.notes: IRS legal name: Black Starr Inc, contact on the filing Gene Bazemore. The website on the tax form leads to a disaster relief site named Dema Dimbaya. Its name does not match the legal name and no link to this filing was found, so its content was not treated as this group's own. That site offers donations and a scholarship page only, with no volunteer role, class, or event a newcomer can join, and no Philadelphia program is shown. Hidden as private pending evidence of a public program. The copyright footer reads 2020, which is not evidence of activity.

records.name: Bottle Underground
records.notes: Held back: no summary or category could be confirmed. The website returned a TLS handshake error on three attempts (www host, bare domain, and trailing slash). One search for Bottle Underground Philadelphia found no venue or group by that name. IRS legal name: Bottle Underground Inc. IRS address 1901 S 9th Street, not confirmed. Needs a manual check of what the group does before any record goes live.

records.name: Discovery Pathways
records.summary: A South Philadelphia nonprofit that teaches nature and environmental skills to young people and adults through boating, fishing, leadership, and greening projects.
records.what_you_do: Join free boating and fishing sessions at FDR Park, take part in youth leadership or community greening work, paddle with the dragon boat team, or volunteer through the site's volunteer page.

schedule.text: Programs run through the year. The home page lists no specific dates, and the events list it links to was not read.

cost.text: Some programs are free, including FDR Park boating and fishing and school field trips. Other programs were not checked for cost.

first_step.how: Pick a program from the Explore Program links on the site, or use the volunteer page to sign up to help
first_step.basis: The site says its free boating and fishing programs are for all ages and skill levels and explains how to start, with a separate youth application.

records.notes: IRS legal name matches. The site mentions a 2025 state environmental award and 2025 impact figures, but no month is shown, so no last_sign_of_life is recorded and status is probably_active (working site, dated items only by year). Youth programs use an application; adult volunteers use the volunteer page.

records.name: Erehwon Ensemble
records.notes: The group's own site describes an orchestra based in Kingston, New York, with concerts at the Old Dutch Church in Kingston (dated October 25, 2026 and April 18, 2027). No Philadelphia program or venue was found. The IRS filing lists a Philadelphia address (1635 Wharton St), which may be an old address.

records.name: Halcyon Consort
records.summary: A classical chamber music group based in Philadelphia that gives public concerts, most of them in other towns or online. Tickets for its concerts are sold through its website.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a concert or watch a livestream, or donate to support the group. The site does not list volunteer, audition, or membership options.

schedule.text: Concerts happen a few times a year. The next listed concert is Sunday, January 31, 2027, at 3:00 pm at Main Line Unitarian Church in Devon, PA. The most recent Philadelphia event listed is a virtual house concert on Sunday, February 1, 2026.

cost.text: Tickets are sold online. Ticket prices were not shown on the pages read.

first_step.how: Check the upcoming events page and buy a ticket for a concert or livestream
first_step.basis: Concerts are open to the public with tickets sold online, but the site does not describe auditions, volunteer roles, or membership.

records.notes: IRS legal name: Halcyon Consort Inc. The Feb 1 2026 virtual house concert is listed as played in Philadelphia. Most other listed events were in New York state, Maine, or Delaware, or were livestreams. The community_band tag is the closest music fit; the cheat sheet has no chamber music tag, and the group does not take community players as far as the site shows. The contact page (halcyonconsort.org/contact) was linked but not read.

records.name: Here Kitty Kitty Cat Rescue
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that rescues homeless and unwanted cats and places them in permanent homes, with help from volunteers and donors.
records.what_you_do: Adopt a cat or kitten through the adoption page, donate, or send items from the wish lists. The volunteer, foster, and membership steps are not described on the pages read, so ask the rescue how to help.

schedule.text: No events are listed. The upcoming events section was empty when checked.

cost.text: Adoption fees and donation amounts are on the adoption and donate pages and were not recorded.

first_step.how: Read the adoption info page to start an adoption, or use the contact page to ask how to volunteer
first_step.basis: Adopting needs an application first, and the way to volunteer or foster is not described on the pages read.

records.notes: IRS legal name: Here Kitty Kitty Cat Rescue Inc. The site says it was formerly Zoomies Animal Rescue. The site gives only Philadelphia, PA with no street address, so the IRS address (1529 Reed St) is not recorded as a location. The news items show month and day but no year, so they are not used as dated evidence and status is probably_active (working site, no dated items).

records.name: History First Hand
records.notes: Held back: could not confirm what the group does. The website does not resolve (DNS lookup fails), which matches the earlier liveness check. Not searched: the WebSearch budget was spent on Bottle Underground and Mantua. IRS legal name: History First Hand Inc. IRS address 213 Pierce St. Worth one search on the legal name to see whether the group has moved or closed. If it has closed, change the verdict to hide with hidden_reason defunct.

records.name: Kitten Snatchers
records.summary: A volunteer-run Philadelphia rescue that takes in stray cats and kittens and places them in foster homes until they are adopted.
records.what_you_do: Foster a cat in your home while it waits for adoption, offer temporary hosting, adopt through the online application, or donate.

schedule.text: No recurring events are listed. The Clear the Shelters adoption promotion ran from August 1 to 31, 2026, with reduced adoption fees.

cost.text: Adoption has a fee, reduced during the August 2026 promotion. Amounts were not recorded.

first_step.how: Fill in the foster form or the temporary host form linked on the site, or use the contact page to ask questions
first_step.basis: Fostering and adopting both start with an application. The site does not describe orientation, volunteer shifts, or events.

records.notes: IRS legal name: Kittensnatchers. The group has no physical shelter and works through foster homes. The IRS street address (164 Sigel St) is not on the site, so it is not recorded as a location. The contact page and social accounts are linked on the site but were not read.

records.name: Louise Nevelson Foundation
records.notes: IRS legal name: Louise Nevelson Foundation Inc. The site says it manages the legacy of the artist Louise Nevelson (catalogue, permissions, trademark). Its legal structure is not stated. It lists no tours, classes, or events a visitor can join, so it is hidden as private. The site lists a Philadelphia PO Box and contact details; they are not recorded here. The 2025 and 1979 dates on the page refer to media appearances, not events.

records.name: Mantua Theater Project
records.summary: A youth theater group in West Philadelphia that helps young people write their own 10 minute plays, then stages them with professional directors and actors in free public performances.
records.what_you_do: Join a month of playwriting classes and a weekend retreat to write a short play, see the free public performances, or volunteer or mentor by emailing the executive director.

schedule.text: Playwriting classes run for about a month, followed by a weekend retreat. No show dates were shown on the page read.

cost.text: Performances are free to the public. The page does not list any cost to take part.

first_step.how: Email Nick Anselmo at mantuatheatreproject@gmail.com to ask about the next playwriting program, or to volunteer or mentor
first_step.basis: Performances are open to anyone, but the page does not say how children enroll or what ages are accepted, so the way to take part is unclear.

records.notes: The group's own site (mantuatheaterproject.com) could not be read: its TLS certificate names a different host. This record relies on the Drexel University partner page, which is undated. A search result mentioned a February 2025 article in The Triangle, but the link opened as the newspaper homepage, so that date is not used. Status is unknown until a dated item is found. Volunteers and mentors come from Philadelphia, its suburbs, and Drexel. IRS address 2508 Carpenter St is not recorded as a location. Executive director phone numbers appear on the Drexel page and are not recorded here.

records.name: MARX Inc Youth Services
records.summary: A youth services group that supports teens with leadership, mentoring, and scholarships to help them grow into adult leaders.
records.what_you_do: Email the group to ask about its leadership and mentoring programs for teens. The site does not describe how to enroll or how to volunteer.

schedule.text: No program dates or schedule are published on the site.

cost.text: Not published. The site invites donations through its Donate page.

first_step.how: Email marxincyouth@gmail.com to ask about teen programs and to be added to the news list
first_step.basis: Programs exist for teens, but the site does not say how a teen signs up, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: IRS legal name: Motivating Adolescents to Reach for Excellence. The everyday name is MARX Inc. The site has a copyright footer of 2021, which is not counted as evidence. No dated news or events were found, so status is probably_active on a working-site basis only. No address is published, so the IRS address (1312 S 15th St) is not recorded. Eligibility and ages are not published; open_to is set to public because the site invites contact and does not restrict it.

records.name: Nanna's Lap
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that helps children of color in foster or adoptive care feel proud of their hair and themselves, through hair care and education.
records.what_you_do: Use the contact form or email the group to ask how to help. The site does not list volunteer roles, events, or classes.

schedule.text: No events or schedule are listed on the pages read.

cost.text: Donations are accepted. No program fees are published.

first_step.how: Use the contact form on the contact page, or email info@nannaslap.org, and ask how to help
first_step.basis: The site invites questions and gives ways to reach the group, but volunteer roles and any sign up steps are not described.

records.notes: IRS legal name: Nanna's Lap Corp. The phone number is published with an 856 area code, recorded as published. The site has no dated news or events, so status is probably_active on a working-site basis only. Program eligibility is not stated; open_to is public because the site does not restrict who may ask about the group.

records.name: Nile Valley Collective
records.notes: IRS legal name: Nile Valley Collective. A group of scholars on ancient Nile Valley cultures that advises museums and teachers through a web contact form only. The listed events are academic talks, conferences, and recordings, mostly online or out of town, with none in Philadelphia. There is no open membership, volunteer route, or public program a newcomer can join, so it is hidden as private.

notes: Batch held 15 groups, not 16. Every group got at least one fetch of its own site. Liveness data from the batch was used as a starting point and checked: Athletic Base Ball's sitemap lastmod 2026-05-18 is confirmed (not an event, so probably_active); History First Hand's domain does not resolve. Two WebSearch calls were used (both of the 2 allowed): Bottle Underground (no matching Philadelphia group found, so held back without summary) and Mantua Theater Project (led to the Drexel partner page, which was read). Four groups are hidden as private: Barefoot Artists, Black Starr Inc (the tax-form website is a disaster relief site whose name does not match the legal name, so it was not treated as this group's own), Louise Nevelson Foundation, and Nile Valley Collective. Erehwon Ensemble is out of area (Kingston, NY). No rate limiting was seen; the errors were per site (TLS and DNS). Budget: 24 fetches of 60, 2 searches of 2.
